column1: # World Engine release payloads: the files a node fetches at install instead
# of finding them in the .adosplug archive. One row per release asset:
# The asset name is the GitHub release asset (and the file name the release
# workflow and scripts/pack-world-engine-local.sh stage it under). Both append
# a fifth column, the download URL, then hand the list to
# The standalone reconstruction node for a Windows workstation
# (`world-engine-node --standalone`), built on the windows release leg.
# Native helpers of the capture service, built on the x86_64-linux release leg
# by the pinned upstream build scripts (glibc, Ubuntu 24.04 runner):
#     -> <dir>/bin/x86_64-linux/basalt-ados; its licence file is Basalt's and
#        basalt-ados's BSD-3 texts plus every vcpkg port's copyright file.
# aarch64-linux rows are added once that build is part of the release (see
# uv runs the on-device `uv sync --frozen` of the KISS-ICP odometry
# environment; the release workflow stages the pinned, checksum-verified
# musl build and its MIT licence.
# The Rerun web viewer's wasm, served to the GCS half as a plugin asset. Every
# profile serves the GCS module, so every node fetches it.
